title: Analytical sample, analyte and matrix distinction
statement: An analytical sample is a declared material portion whose complete resolved component support is partitioned by held roles into the analyte and retained matrix, together with its source-to-sample map.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete distinction preservation, exact recurrence/equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite declared material portion with complete resolved components, one or more analyte roles and retained non-analyte support.

choices.name: declared-material-portion
choices.reason: The inspected material occurrence is retained.

choices.name: component-support-erased
choices.reason: The portion cannot be compositionally audited.

choices.name: analyte-role-held
choices.reason: The component under determination is explicit.

choices.name: matrix-support-held
choices.reason: All other resolved components remain recorded.

choices.name: sample-equals-whole-source
choices.reason: A portion need not reproduce the source whole.

choices.name: component-response-map-held
choices.reason: Response and carrier identities remain linked.

choices.name: result-only
choices.reason: The sample distinction cannot be reproduced.

choices.name: sample-analyte-matrix-trace
choices.reason: All distinctions and maps are retained.

choices.name: free-sample-rule
choices.reason: A discretionary rule can select any portion.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete bounded support supplies the partition.

induction_base: One bounded two-component portion with one analyte and one matrix component supplies the first partition.
induction_step: Appending a resolved component retains the prior partition and records its analyte or matrix role without erasure.
exclusions: no analytical glossary, calibration curve, spectral database, measured line, fitted profile, target source or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no sample, component, response, transition, reference or unfavorable observation may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite declared material portion with complete resolved components, one or more analyte roles and retained non-analyte support.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at S05451

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks sample portion, analyte, matrix or sampling boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
